title: Tire & Battery Technician - Automotive
description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------


As a Tire \& Battery Center Technician you will work to provide safe and efficient service in both the sales and service areas of the department and deliver to our members more of what they love, for less. You will work collaboratively with other associates to ensure the club meets the member’s expectations.**What you'll do...**
---------------------


Be a Team Member Collaborates with team members to fulfil sales and service requests educating other associates on tools tasks resources and mentor new technicians communicating and developing interpersonal skills for providing safe and efficient customer service  

Be an Expert Demonstrates knowledge of safety and compliance protocols tire and battery industry guidelines service standards equipment operations TPMS Tire Pressure Monitoring systems product specifications and seasonality demonstrating knowledge of Point of Sale systems phone and inperson selling techniques  

Be a Techie Leverages digital tools to plan for and drive sales improve the service experience and elevate associate engagement utilizing hand held technology and systems to make immediate business decisions related to services safety alerts new product information product application and training adapting to new tools and encouraging others to use them  

Be an Owner Communicates equipment tools and supplies needs to TBC Lead tracking and monitoring returns and special orders operating cash registers processing transactions working handson in the physical area maintaining accurate inventory audit safety and compliance standards reporting TBC complaints safety hazards and problems with products services and work areas completing paperwork logs and other required documentation ensuring merchandise is packaged labeled and stored in accordance with company policies and procedures identifying member needs assists members with purchasing decisions and resolves issues and concerns

title: Energy & Utilities Expert (United States)
description:
**Role description**
--------------------



The Energy \& Utilities Expert Commentary role is a remote contract position open to experts located anywhere in the United States.



You will provide clear, accurate commentary on power markets, utilities, oil and gas, renewables, infrastructure, regulation, demand, and energy transition. The expected commitment is approximately four hours per month.



You will review Authority.inc research, datasets, and forecasts to identify errors, weak assumptions, and missing context.



Your commentary will be used to fine\-tune the most accurate forecasting models in the world. These models are designed to predict events, decisions, and outcomes across energy and utilities markets globally.


**About Authority.inc**
-----------------------



Authority.inc is building a global industry intelligence platform powered by data, forecasting, and the firsthand expertise of experienced professionals.



You may be featured as an expert correspondent for your specialist niche, market segment, or geographic area.


**Qualifications**
------------------


* At least five years of professional experience in energy and utilities.
* Deep knowledge of at least one relevant vertical, function, or specialist discipline.
* Firsthand experience with the sector’s decisions, operations, risks, and market dynamics.
* Ability to explain complex topics clearly and concisely in written and verbal form.
* A detail\-oriented approach and commitment to accuracy and consistency.

**Engagement details**
----------------------


* Remote contract position.
* Open to experts located anywhere in the United States.
* Approximately four hours per month.

description:
Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


**Transform the everyday with us!**



We are seeking a **Lead Project Engineer \- Solutions** for a high\-visibility role combining technical expertise, customer engagement, and end\-to\-end solution ownership across the GTD value chain. You will serve as a technical authority spanning offers engineering, orders engineering, and project execution — a role intentionally developed for engineers who want to move beyond narrow, product\-only positions.



The Utility Systems \& Solutions business within Siemens Electrification \& Automation (EA) enables a more reliable, resilient, and sustainable electric grid across the full generation, transmission, and distribution (GTD) value chain. title: Merger and Acquisitions Financial Due Diligence Senior Manager ERI/Infrastructure
description:
Our Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. We offer comprehensive end\-to\-end support and advisory services, covering areas such as valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), and sustainability. The team works closely with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and implement practical solutions before, during, and after major transformational projects or transactions creating lasting impact.  

  

Deloitte's M\&A Services is the recognized marketplace leader among large professional services firms in providing merger, acquisition, and divestiture services to corporate strategic buyers and private equity investors And succeeding in today's private equity market takes more than sharp insights\-it takes a trusted partner who can translate those insights into clear decisions and measurable action. Be that trusted partner and apply to this Senior Manager role today!  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/18/2026  

  

**Work you'll Do**As a Senior Manager in M\&A Financial Due Diligence (FDD), you will be responsible for:  

  

* Advising on technical accounting matters related to transactions, including business combinations, consolidations, share\-based compensation, revenue recognition, leases, intangible assets, and financial instruments.
* Identifying and evaluating business, industry, financial, accounting, and tax risks associated with transactions and assessing their potential implications
* Providing insights on historical and projected earnings, cash flows, contingencies, commitments, exposures, asset quality, and internal control structures
* Reviewing financial models and transaction documents, including stock purchase agreements, merger agreements, bank finance agreements, and public debt off

title: Sys VP NRES Facility Management
description:
**Job Summary and Responsibilities**  

As our System VP, NRES Facility Management, you will transform, lead, and oversee the facility management operations of the entire real estate portfolio, encompassing critical functions like maintenance, systems operations, compliance, and utility management across our Integrated Delivery Network (IDN).  

  

Every day, you will collaborate extensively with NRES, other national programs, and regional/local operating teams to develop and operate an industry\-leading facility management and compliance program focused on efficiency, cost, staff satisfaction, and sustainability. You will align resources to build high\-performing teams, developing innovative staffing, training, and retention programs to address workforce needs and increase our industry profile. You will lead workforce transformation by introducing processes, tools, and technology to enhance efficiencies, reduce operational risks, and optimize resource deployment.  

  

To be successful in your role, you will lead the development and deployment of Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for the Facility Management program, including master and site\-level agreements to govern finances, services, and performance. You will be responsible for developing and aggregating annual operating budgets, administering performance evaluations, and meeting KPIs for financial measures, risk reductions, staff metrics, compliance, and sustainability. You will partner with NRES, partner organizations, and corporate departments to develop the real estate and facility management data cube, guiding the development of the Single Source of Truth platform, NRES dashboards, and data transparency for critical operational and optimization decision\-making.

title: Battery Energy Storage (BESS) Construction Manager
description:
**Company Overview**  
Accord Power is a leading renewable energy developer and EPC contractor delivering commercial, industrial, and public\-sector clean energy solutions throughout the region. With more than a decade of experience designing and building high\-performance solar energy systems, we are expanding our footprint in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), microgrids, and distributed energy infrastructure.

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to resilient, intelligent, and sustainable energy systems. We are a fast\-growing team of innovators, builders, and problem\-solvers passionate about shaping the future of clean energy through cutting\-edge solar \+ storage projects.

**Job Summary**  
The Battery Energy Storage (BESS) Construction Manager will lead the execution of standalone energy storage and solar \+ storage projects from preconstruction through commissioning. This role is responsible for overseeing field operations, managing subcontractors and schedules, coordinating with utilities and AHJs, and ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget.

The ideal candidate has strong experience managing electrical and civil construction projects, understands complex distributed energy systems, and thrives in fast\-paced environments where technical expertise and leadership are equally valued.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day\-to\-day field operations for BESS and renewable energy construction projects, ensuring safe and efficient execution across all project phases.
* Manage project schedules, subcontractors, vendors, equipment logistics, and workforce coordination.
* Prepare and respond to bids, proposals, and RFPs, including detailed project takeoffs, estimating, and scope reviews.
* Coordinate with utilities, AHJs, inspectors, and permitting agencies including Con Edison, DOB, and FDNY.

title: Energy Systems Field Foreman
description:
**About VeriWatt**

VeriWatt, LLC is an energy services company providing solar and battery storage installation, third\-party verification, operations and maintenance, and energy project development services to tribal nations, commercial clients, and public utilities across the region. We are a growing company built on accountability, technical excellence, and the responsible development of energy resources. Our team works in the field every day and is committed to doing the work right.

**Position Summary**

The Energy Systems Field Foreman provides on\-site leadership and supervision for the installation, commissioning, and maintenance of solar photovoltaic systems, battery energy storage systems, and related balance\-of\-system components. This is a working foreman role: the Foreman performs hands\-on technical work alongside the field crew while carrying primary responsibility for crew direction, quality oversight, and site coordination. The ideal candidate is an experienced energy professional who is equally comfortable turning wrenches and engaging with inspectors, utility representatives, and clients. The Foreman is the primary field point of contact on every project and is responsible for ensuring work is performed safely, on schedule, and to VeriWatt’s quality standards.

This position may based in the Tulsa/ Northeast Oklahoma or Joplin, MO area and requires regular multi\-state travel. A company vehicle is provided for business use.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Direct field crews and subcontractors on solar PV, battery storage, and balance\-of\-system installations from mobilization through commissioning
* Ensure all work is performed in compliance with project plans, applicable electrical codes, OSHA safety requirements, and VeriWatt quality standards
* Serve as the primary field liaison with inspectors, utility representatives, and site contacts during project execution
* Coordinate with project management on scheduling, material procurement, and prog

title: Maintenance Technician A
description:
**Position Description**
------------------------



Uses advanced technical knowledge to troubleshoot and repair all plant equipment, building and grounds. Performs a wide variety of skilled maintenance work to maintain structures, electrical systems, heating systems, plumbing, machine repair, electrical systems, hydraulics systems for a variety of equipment.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


Troubleshoots and repairs equipment using programmable logic controllers (PLC) Performs various duties relating to automation and robotics, machine shop fabrication, preventative maintenance using specialized equipment and various machining or bench operations to alter and repair tools, fixtures, gauges, and guarding. Works closely with engineers and outside vendors to resolve complex process or equipment issues in a cost effective and timely manner. Trains employees; assigns and directs work; provides feedback to supervisor regarding employee work performance; addresses complaints and resolves problems. Performs other duties as assigned.
**Job Skills Requirements**
---------------------------


* Advanced troubleshooting skills using mechanical, electrical, hydraulic knowledge
